en: The earth calls to you, $N. Go to it, and know that your brethren are proud of you and all you will accomplish.
Thank you again, $n. I'll make my way to the road now. When you can, find Terenthis and let him know we escaped.
The serum will only take a few minutes to prepare, $n.
Still no sign of the final shipment of explosives.
I need assistance in recovering a piece of my Confessor's Raiment, Al'tabim.
A fellowship of kindred spirits can be a powerful force.  Krumn will help you to achieve this.  You will find him at the Thunder Bluff Civic Information center on the lower rise next to the lifts.
Us see balloon north of ruins up above.  It take you to far off places.
I risk my own life and free him so that he may prove his innocence.  If I can, I'll help him in any way.
%s raises the gun to his shoulder, aims it carefully then fires a shot at the target.

A-ten-hut! All Ahn'Qiraj war materiel accounted for and in the process of being transported to Cenarion Hold $g sir : ma'am;! I am told that the last of it should arrive in less than a day. Once that is done, and someone rings that gong over there to open the gates, I guarantee that we'll give those bugs one heck of a fight!
That's right, it's over by the bed.  Heh, sorry about that!

The spirit looks upon you with a sense of completeness and cognizance that had not been present before.$B$B"I feel as though a great burden has been lifted from my soul.  Soon I will rest forever in peace.  I now know this, and I await this time patiently.$B$BThank you, stranger."

Ah, Braenna Flintcrag.  She has magic hands, that one.  Braenna is the one to see about Priestly matters.  

Ye'll want to travel north from the gates of Ironforge to the Hall of Mysteries.  That's where ye'll find her.
The Syndicate is made up of a bunch of hacks - disorganized, unskilled, and lazy...
Be strong, Fizzule!
Me no run from $C like you!
My name is Dran Droffers, and this over here is my dummy son Malton.  If you need salvage, or are looking to sell salvage, then we're who you need to be talking to!
You've plundered our treasures too long.  Prepare to meet your watery grave!
I've seen farmers with staves hold off trained soldiers. Do not ever underestimate the power and skill it takes to wield one of these properly.
More of the Warden's errand boys!
It's my way or the Gold Road.  Is that understood?

Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!
Ah, freedom!  Although brief, so sweet it is...
Feeling blue? Come on down to the Blue Recluse for a good time!
Don't let me catch you stealing anything!  Look for Shenthul and his Shadowswift Brotherhood in the underground Cleft of Shadow.  Find the tunnel leading down into it south of the Valley of Wisdom.
Teach me how to create and apply a Runecloth Bandage, Doctor.

Yes, but you'll find it more rewarding if you have skill in herbalism!  You'll be nurturing and cultivating special seeds.  While the Evergreen Pouch you'll receive allows even a novice to grow something, those who show some aptitude in herbalism will have more bountiful results.
I hope Ogron finds that pinkskin and breaks his legs. See how he survives in the marsh like that!
%s inspects the snapjaw shells...
Upgrade to seasoned units!
Well, ye won't have much luck with finding a tailor out here.  Ironforge is home to a quite a few talented tailors though.  Why don't ye go ask a guard there.
Soon child... very soon.
Mistress!! They seek to destroy your work!!
Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!
Have you any idea what I go through to bring these incomparable valuables to sell?  Come see them all for yourself!
The master has fallen!  Avenge him, my brethren!
I see you misplaced that chapter you worked so hard to put together, $n. Well, you left it right here!
You have not yet earned the right to train with me. See Thund first, over by the table. Come back when he says you're ready!
So that's how Windsor died...
